name: boss-all
about: Boss Rush: The Proctor (a hulking examiner in a square cap with a red pencil). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss12-proctor-sd-0; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound whole to the bone that owns it, so the armour stays rigid on a motion-captured skeleton.
bar: the game's one quality bar for a hero model (2026-11-17): 2048 px colour, 1024 px other maps, about 55K triangles
